S.FORM: alang Kalaluran ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Taitung Si, kwara sali buwan nya ga 193 buwan, 536 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 90% kyan ku 484 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 10% kyan ku 52 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 74%, Amis 5%, Tayan 1%, Rukay 2%, Puyuma 2%, binah lihuyan s'uli 5%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Kalaluran hya' ga bsilung. tay 'zil na Kalaluran hya' ga rgyax. tay mkyahu' na Kalaluran hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Kalaluran hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Kalaluran hya' ga Kasavakan. tay 'zil na Kalaluran hya' ga Pakurung. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Kalaluran ga ungat biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ kalaluran ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu taituŋ [s|ɕ]i kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa pajwan ** ami[s|ɕ] * tajan * rukaj * pujuma * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na kalaluran ħjaʔ ɣa β[s|ɕ]iluŋ taj ʔzil na kalaluran ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj mkjaħuʔ na kalaluran ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na kalaluran ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na kalaluran ħjaʔ ɣa ka[s|ɕ]a*akan taj ʔzil na kalaluran ħjaʔ ɣa pakuruŋ reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ kalaluran ɣa uŋat βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
